coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
Waking up, using the toilet, showering with the water heater, brushing teeth and washing
Making breakfast with the kettle and toaster and eating breakfast at the counter
Getting dressed in work clothes, packing a lunch bag and checking the phone for the day's patient schedule
Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift by public transport (bus/train), since the household ElectricVehicle is not used by Member 1
Working as a hospital physiotherapist, assessing inpatients and running individual rehabilitation sessions
Taking a lunch break at the hospital cafeteria and eating a packed lunch
Continuing physiotherapy duties: group exercise sessions, mobility training and updating patient records
Commuting home from the hospital after the shift by public transport (bus/train)
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker with the range hood on, then eating dinner and loading the dishwasher
Showering with the water heater and changing into comfortable home clothes
Reading physiotherapy journals and reviewing treatment notes on the computer under the desk lamp
Watching TV and doing light stretching and mobility exercises on the floor with the air conditioner on
Preparing a hot drink with the kettle, tidying the kitchen and setting out breakfast items for tomorrow
Winding down in bed, checking the phone and setting the alarm for the next shift
Sleeping with the light off and the air conditioner on for the night
